jobs.description: Step into the world of logistics in Tilburg, where innovation meets teamwork in a modern warehouse environment. Sounds like your kind of job? Let's get started! Wie zoeken we? We value team players who take initiative, stay positive under pressure, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You’re someone who works accurately and brings energy to every shift. With a hands-on mentality and a sense of responsibility, you help keep operations running smoothly. You're a great match for this role if you: Communicate effectively in English (basic level is sufficient) Have previous experience in logistics or warehouse operations Have your own transport, as the location is not accessible by public transportation Are available to work full-time from Monday to Friday, 08:00 - 17:00 Hold a valid EPT/RT certificate Wat bieden wij je? You’ll be working in a modern warehouse with a supportive and international team. Every day brings new challenges, and you’ll have the chance to grow, learn, and contribute to a fast-moving logistics environment where your efforts truly make a difference. Here's what you can count on: An hourly wage starting at €14.99 Travel allowance to cover your commute (starting from 10 km home-work) Secure and long-term position with great growth potential Opportunities to develop your skills and grow within the company Functieomschrijving For a large and fast‑growing international logistics company in Tilburg, we’re looking for a motivated full‑time warehouse employee to join the day shift team. The company recently opened a brand‑new, modern warehouse and is getting ready to introduce innovative technologies to make daily operations even more efficient. This is a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic environment and support the company’s continued growth across Europe. You’ll play an important role in the daily logistics processes. Your tasks include: Understanding and following WMS processes for smooth order handling Safely operating an EPT (reachtruck experience is a bonus) Handling multiple tasks and switching easily in a busy warehouse Ensuring efficient and well‑organized logistics flows Processing, sorting, and preparing goods for shipment Using systems and equipment to support daily operations Working closely with your team to reach daily goals This is a full‑time position, Monday to Friday, from 08:00 to 17:00. Are you looking for a fresh start at an innovative company where you can grow, learn, and make a real impact? Click the button below and send us your application today!
